technical.summary: Mixed bullish short-term momentum (RSI, EMA 9/21 cross, supertrend) conflicts with bearish intermediate structure (MACD, EMA 20/50, Ichimoku cloud), weak trend strength (ADX 16.8), and overbought conditions; moderate confluence but elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 43 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (306.4), rising dollar, and recent CPI miss creating recession risk; earnings in 43 days adds moderate event risk to already hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum confluence (EMA 9/21 golden cross, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku TK cross, OBV bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (20/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support at 120.77.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 306.4, rising dollar), bearish intermediate structure (MACD negative, EMA 20/50 bearish, price below 50/200 SMA), weak trend strength (ADX 16.8), and high earnings risk in 43 days overwhelm short-term bullish signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (EMA 9/21 cross, supertrend) and extreme fear sentiment (20/100) create a contrarian setup at support. However, severe macro deterioration, bearish intermediate structure, and weak trend strength (ADX 16.8) make this a low-conviction entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis (306.4), and earnings event in 43 days create compounding macro and event risk that outweighs short-term technical bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate winner is bear with high confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 16 Health Care positions with existing ABBV exposure; sector concentration and portfolio saturation reduce conviction further and warrant position avoidance.
